name: invoice-reader
description: Read invoice PDFs into one checked spreadsheet.

interface.longDescription:
Zovo Invoice Reader turns invoice PDFs into one spreadsheet and checks the tax, totals and money math of each invoice. Attach up to 20 text-based invoice PDFs. You get an Excel workbook with an Invoices sheet (file, vendor, invoice number, invoice date, due date, currency, subtotal, tax, shipping, reductions, total, amount due, check status) and a Line items sheet (description, quantity, unit cost, amount), plus the same data as CSV files.

Three checks run on each invoice with integer cent math. The lines add up to the subtotal. Subtotal minus reductions plus tax and shipping equals the total. Quantity times unit cost equals each line amount. Each check shows PASS, MISMATCH with the difference, or NOT CHECKABLE when the invoice does not print the value needed. A missing reduction, tax or shipping line counts as 0, and the check says so.

It reads US (1,234.56) and European (1.234,56) number formats, decided once per file, and dates such as 10/05/2026, 05.10.2026 or 14 October 2026. VAT, GST, HST and sales tax lines are found, and several tax lines are added together. Line items that continue on the next page and descriptions that wrap onto two lines are joined. Possible duplicate invoice numbers across files are flagged.

You can also type the amounts of an invoice and check its math without a file.

Good for accounts payable, bookkeeping, expense reviews, and month-end close.

Limitations: text-based PDFs only (scanned or photographed invoices are reported, not guessed; run OCR first). Up to 20 files, 10 MB and 20 pages per file. Labels are read in English. The vendor name is a guess from the top of the first page when no From or Vendor label is printed. Generated files are kept for 1 hour, then deleted.
defaultPrompt: Read the attached invoice PDFs into one spreadsheet and check their totals
Check this invoice: 4 x 42.50 = 170.00, 2 x 89.99 = 179.98, subtotal 349.98, tax 28.87, total 378.85
Pull vendor, invoice number, due date and total from these supplier invoices into Excel

positive.description: One US invoice into a checked spreadsheet
positive.prompt: Read the attached invoice PDF into a spreadsheet and check its math
positive.expected_behavior: Calls read_invoices with the attached inv01-us.pdf. Reports vendor Northwind Office Supply, invoice INV-1001 dated 2026-10-05, subtotal 392.73, tax 32.40, total 425.13 USD, 3 lines, status PASS for all checks. Offers an Excel workbook and a CSV ZIP.

positive.description: Typed invoice amounts that add up
positive.prompt: Check this invoice: 4 x 42.50 = 170.00, 2 x 89.99 = 179.98, subtotal 349.98, tax 28.87, total 378.85
positive.expected_behavior: Calls check_invoice_math with the two lines, subtotal 349.98, tax 28.87 and total 378.85. Overall PASS: the lines add up to 349.98, the computed total is 378.85, and each line equals quantity x unit price.

positive.prompt: Does the attached catering invoice add up?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls read_invoices with the attached inv05-total-mismatch.pdf. Status MISMATCH: the lines add up to the subtotal 505.00, but 505.00 + 25.25 = 530.25 while the total says 540.25, a difference of 10.00.

positive.description: Typed line with a wrong amount
positive.prompt: Is this invoice line right: 3 wireless mice at 19.99 each, amount 69.97, subtotal 69.97, total 69.97?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls check_invoice_math with qty 3, unit_price 19.99, amount 69.97, subtotal 69.97 and total 69.97. Overall MISMATCH: 3 x 19.99 = 59.97, printed 69.97, a difference of 10.00. The lines-sum and totals checks pass.

positive.prompt: Put the two attached invoices into one Excel file with their line items
positive.expected_behavior: Calls read_invoices with inv02-eu.pdf and inv07-multipage.pdf. Reports 2 invoices, both PASS: Bergmann Software GmbH total 4253.73 EUR read from the European format, and Midwest Fastener Supply total 8130.86 USD with 46 lines across 2 pages. Offers one Excel workbook and a CSV ZIP.

negative.description: A question about tax law needs no file reading. Expected: no tool call; a general answer.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read 1 to 20 text-based invoice PDFs into an Excel workbook (Invoices and Line items) and CSV files, with three arithmetic checks per invoice and a math check for typed amounts.

pl-PL.subtitle: Faktury PDF do Excela
pl-PL.description:
Zovo Invoice Reader zamienia faktury PDF w jeden arkusz i sprawdza rachunki każdej faktury. Dołącz do 20 faktur PDF z tekstem. Dostajesz skoroszyt Excel z arkuszem Faktury (plik, sprzedawca, numer faktury, data wystawienia, termin płatności, waluta, suma netto, podatek, wysyłka, rabat, suma, kwota do zapłaty, wynik kontroli) i arkuszem Pozycje (opis, ilość, cena jednostkowa, kwota) oraz te same dane w plikach CSV.

Trzy kontrole liczone w całych groszach: pozycje sumują się do sumy netto; suma netto minus rabat plus podatek i wysyłka daje sumę; ilość razy cena daje kwotę pozycji. Wynik to PASS, MISMATCH z różnicą albo NOT CHECKABLE, gdy na fakturze brakuje wartości.

Ograniczenia: tylko PDF z tekstem (skany są zgłaszane, nie zgadywane), do 20 plików, 10 MB i 20 stron na plik, etykiety po angielsku. Pliki wynikowe są przechowywane 1 godzinę, potem usuwane.

de-DE.subtitle: Rechnungs-PDFs nach Excel
de-DE.description:
Zovo Invoice Reader macht aus Rechnungs-PDFs eine Tabelle und prüft die Rechnung jeder Rechnung. Hängen Sie bis zu 20 textbasierte Rechnungs-PDFs an. Sie erhalten eine Excel-Arbeitsmappe mit dem Blatt Rechnungen (Datei, Lieferant, Rechnungsnummer, Rechnungsdatum, Fälligkeit, Währung, Zwischensumme, Steuer, Versand, Rabatt, Gesamt, offener Betrag, Prüfstatus) und dem Blatt Positionen (Beschreibung, Menge, Einzelpreis, Betrag) sowie dieselben Daten als CSV.

Drei Prüfungen in ganzen Cent: Die Positionen ergeben die Zwischensumme; Zwischensumme minus Rabatt plus Steuer und Versand ergibt die Gesamtsumme; Menge mal Einzelpreis ergibt den Positionsbetrag. Ergebnis: PASS, MISMATCH mit Differenz oder NOT CHECKABLE, wenn ein Wert fehlt.

Einschränkungen: nur PDFs mit Text (Scans werden gemeldet, nicht geraten), bis 20 Dateien, 10 MB und 20 Seiten pro Datei, Beschriftungen auf Englisch. Erzeugte Dateien werden 1 Stunde gespeichert und dann gelöscht.

es-ES.subtitle: Facturas PDF a Excel
es-ES.description:
Zovo Invoice Reader convierte facturas PDF en una hoja de cálculo y revisa las cuentas de cada factura. Adjunta hasta 20 facturas PDF con texto. Obtienes un libro de Excel con la hoja Facturas (archivo, proveedor, número, fecha, vencimiento, moneda, subtotal, impuesto, envío, descuento, total, importe pendiente, estado de la revisión) y la hoja Líneas (descripción, cantidad, precio unitario, importe), además de los mismos datos en CSV.

Tres comprobaciones en céntimos enteros: las líneas suman el subtotal; subtotal menos descuento más impuesto y envío da el total; cantidad por precio da el importe de cada línea. Resultado: PASS, MISMATCH con la diferencia o NOT CHECKABLE si falta un valor.

Limitaciones: solo PDF con texto (los escaneos se indican, no se adivinan), hasta 20 archivos, 10 MB y 20 páginas por archivo, etiquetas en inglés. Los archivos generados se guardan 1 hora y luego se eliminan.

fr-FR.subtitle: Factures PDF vers Excel
fr-FR.description:
Zovo Invoice Reader transforme des factures PDF en un tableur et vérifie les calculs de chaque facture. Joignez jusqu'à 20 factures PDF avec du texte. Vous obtenez un classeur Excel avec une feuille Factures (fichier, fournisseur, numéro, date, échéance, devise, sous-total, taxe, livraison, remise, total, montant dû, statut du contrôle) et une feuille Lignes (description, quantité, prix unitaire, montant), ainsi que les mêmes données en CSV.

Trois contrôles en centimes entiers : les lignes donnent le sous-total ; sous-total moins remise plus taxe et livraison donne le total ; quantité fois prix unitaire donne le montant de la ligne. Résultat : PASS, MISMATCH avec l'écart, ou NOT CHECKABLE s'il manque une valeur.

Limites : PDF avec texte uniquement (les scans sont signalés, pas devinés), jusqu'à 20 fichiers, 10 Mo et 20 pages par fichier, libellés en anglais. Les fichiers générés sont conservés 1 heure, puis supprimés.

ja-JP.subtitle: 請求書PDFをExcelに
ja-JP.description:
Zovo Invoice Reader は請求書PDFを1つの表にまとめ、各請求書の計算を確認します。テキストを含む請求書PDFを最大20件添付できます。請求書シート（ファイル、取引先、請求書番号、請求日、支払期日、通貨、小計、税、送料、値引き、合計、請求額、確認結果）と明細シート（内容、数量、単価、金額）を持つExcelブックと、同じ内容のCSVファイルを作成します。

確認はセント単位の整数計算で3つ行います。明細の合計が小計と一致するか、小計−値引き＋税＋送料が合計と一致するか、数量×単価が各明細の金額と一致するか。結果は PASS、差額付きの MISMATCH、値が無い場合の NOT CHECKABLE です。

制限事項：テキストPDFのみ（スキャンは報告のみで推測しません）、最大20ファイル、1ファイル10 MB・20ページまで、ラベルは英語。作成したファイルは1時間保存され、その後削除されます。

pt-BR.subtitle: Faturas PDF para Excel
pt-BR.description:
O Zovo Invoice Reader transforma faturas em PDF em uma planilha e confere as contas de cada fatura. Anexe até 20 faturas PDF com texto. Você recebe uma pasta de trabalho do Excel com a aba Faturas (arquivo, fornecedor, número, data, vencimento, moeda, subtotal, imposto, frete, desconto, total, valor devido, status da conferência) e a aba Itens (descrição, quantidade, preço unitário, valor), além dos mesmos dados em CSV.

Três conferências em centavos inteiros: os itens somam o subtotal; subtotal menos desconto mais imposto e frete dá o total; quantidade vezes preço unitário dá o valor do item. Resultado: PASS, MISMATCH com a diferença ou NOT CHECKABLE quando falta um valor.

Limitações: apenas PDF com texto (digitalizações são informadas, não adivinhadas), até 20 arquivos, 10 MB e 20 páginas por arquivo, rótulos em inglês. Os arquivos gerados ficam guardados por 1 hora e depois são apagados.
